g.text: Desktop build: 16x2 LCD (PCF8574 I2C backpack) via BSS138 level shifter
Raspberry Pi 5 / Pi 4. Physical header pin numbers, BCM GPIO names. Power off before wiring. Source: hardware/SPEC.md §3.1, §3.2, §3.5
Wire colours: red 5 V · orange 3.3 V · black GND · blue I2C SDA · yellow I2C SCL · green panel button (GPIO17)

g.title: PI
g.text: Only the pins used by this build are shown.

g.title: W2
g.text: to the LCD backpack (2 from the Pi, 2 from the level shifter)

g.title: W3
g.text: Dupont jumper F-F, far housing cut off
Female housing on the Pi. Button end: strip 5 mm,
solder to the lug under 4.8 mm heat-shrink, or clamp in the screw terminal.

g.title: LS
g.text: LV side = 3.3 V (Pi), HV side = 5 V (LCD). Never swap.
Adafruit 757 marks LV1/LV2 as A1/A2 and HV1/HV2 as B1/B2.

g.title: LCD
g.text: Wire by the labels printed on the backpack.
Backlight on but no text: turn the contrast trimmer.

g.title: BUTTON
g.text: Panel button, 16 mm momentary, normally open
2-lug switch - either way round. 3-lug switch - use C and NO, leave NC free.
